name: Vellichor books
description: Reads EPUB books aloud as narration, a chapter at every narration band. Each book on its shelf lists as a series and each chapter as a piece of it, taken from EPUB addresses the operator gives (Project Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks, a Calibre-Web instance, or their own file server), cleaned of markup and footnotes and cached so a book is not fetched again.
author: VinewZ
